verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same failures. The translucent panel is gone, so dark text sits directly on a busy, blurry, over-enlarged city photo. 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' has been moved to the far left, away from 'London', so the headline reads in the wrong order. The two small chevron groups have become six oversized arrows that dominate the middle. The tagline floats on its own, and there is no grid or clear hierarchy.
